item.title: ASAB Research Grants
item.why_it_fits: Up to £10k (£15k with justification), explicitly to fund travel to conduct collaborative research or bring a collaborator to you — strong match for a methods exchange (e.g. GLM-HMM/behavioural-modelling).
item.eligibility_notes: Does not usually accept applicants based in the Americas — no issue, Spain-based.
